verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile terminal and coding environment that ships local shell commands, so built-in git tooling such as interactive rebase is a fair question for it. However, the documented local command list (cat, grep, ls, cp, etc.) includes no git. Nothing in the evidence shows that Blink itself can delete, edit, squash, or reorder commits; it only provides SSH/Mosh access to remote machines and VS Code connectivity.
